scenes.title: Arrival at the Orchard
scenes.summary: Vespera Vale returns to The Glass Orchard and sees The Amber Pruners waiting at the gate.
scenes.prose: Vespera Vale reached The Glass Orchard at dusk. The Amber Pruners watched from beneath the glass leaves. Calder Wick carried the Silver Vial.

scenes.title: Unanchored Interlude
scenes.summary: A quiet storm passes over unnamed fields.
scenes.prose: Rain stitched the dark fields while a bell rang far away.
